description: JG v2.0 revision (ZQH comment 2.2): add a random-walk component to the injected noise and carry it through the downstream velocity/uncertainty pipeline. Compares WN+FN with WN+FN+RW under the same estimators (noise re-estimated with wn+fn+rw on the raw series), reporting velocity bias, reported vs empirical sigma, calibration ratio and 1-sigma coverage for raw, denoised and gap-filled series.
